harness_design.isolation: 10 Explore subagents, one per initial, dispatched in a SINGLE Claude Code message (parallel). Each agent has its own context window — does NOT see others' code or earlier conversation. Read-only Tools (Read/Grep/Glob/Bash for ls); no Edit/Write.
harness_design.brief_template: Templated per initial: root path + same include/exclude criteria + same caps (depth 6, files 500, candidates 10, excluded 15) + same output schema (## INITIAL → candidates[] / excluded[] / conventions_observed[] / open_questions[]).
harness_design.aggregation: Manual collation by the orchestrator (this script-as-conversation). Each agent's Markdown output is parsed for the four fixed sections and folded into this JSON DB.
harness_design.rerun_cost: ~3-8 minutes per agent depending on tree size + read latency (SMB-mounted). Parallel dispatch fits in one wall-clock window of ~10 min for 10 researchers.
future_automation_hooks: scripts/scan-csnl-conventions.md — written guide for re-running the harness (Claude Code session, paste prompt, dispatch, collect)
Could be wrapped in a tiny driver later — but the parallel-subagent step is inherently Claude-Code-bound; a plain script can't dispatch isolated-context agents.
